decision_conditions:
Commencement of development (Full Permission) - The development to which this permission relates shall be commenced not later than the expiration of 3 years from the date of this permission.

Reason:  To comply with Section 91 (as amended) of the Town & Country Planning Act 1990.

<p class="MsoNormal"><u>External
Materials as Specified</u> -
The facing materials to be used for the development hereby permitted shall be
those specified in the application form (specified as tiles to the dormer
window to match the existing roof) unless otherwise agreed in writing by the
Local Planning Authority.<o:p></o:p></p><p style="text-align: justify;"><span style="font-size:12.0pt;line-height:107%;
font-family:" arial",sans-serif;mso-fareast-font-family:aptos;mso-fareast-theme-font:="" minor-latin;mso-ansi-language:en-gb;mso-fareast-language:en-us;mso-bidi-language:="" ar-sa"=""><span style="font-size: 12pt; line-height: 107%;"><u><span style="font-size: 14px;">Reason</span></u><span style="font-size: 14px;">:&nbsp; To ensure a satisfactory
appearance of the development and to comply with the following Development Plan
policies for Merton: policies D4 and D8 of the London Plan 2021, policies D12.1
and D12.3 of the Local Plan 2024.</span><s></s></span></span></p>
